input.title: Drive-apps are custom editors for the drive document itself, providing specialized views like Kanban boards or aggregated dashboards over drive contents

input.description: A drive is a document; Drive-apps are editors for it. They get context from window.ph hooks (not DriveEditorContext, which is gone) and configure via PHAppConfig.
